questions.prompt: When I win a game, I feel ___.
questions.explanation_ar: لما بكسب لعبة بحس بالسعادة: happy. sad حزين وangry غاضب.
questions.explanation_en: When I win a game I feel happy: happy. sad is حزين and angry is غاضب.

questions.prompt: When I see a big dog, I feel ___. (خائف)
questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (خائف) معناها scared. لما أشوف كلب كبير ممكن أخاف.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (خائف) means scared. When I see a big dog I may be scared.

questions.prompt: When my toy breaks, I feel ___.
questions.explanation_ar: لما لعبتي بتتكسر بحزن: sad. happy وexcited مشاعر فرح.
questions.explanation_en: When my toy breaks I feel sad: sad. happy and excited are happy feelings.

questions.prompt: When I wait for my birthday, I feel ___. (متحمس)
questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (متحمس) معناها excited، وبنبقى متحمسين وإحنا مستنيين عيد ميلادنا.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (متحمس) means excited, and we are excited while waiting for our birthday.

questions.prompt: When someone takes my pen, I feel ___.
questions.explanation_ar: لما حد ياخد قلمي بتضايق وأتعصب: angry. shy معناها خجول وhappy سعيد.
questions.explanation_en: When someone takes my pen I get upset and angry: angry. shy means خجول and happy is سعيد.

questions.prompt: After running for an hour, I feel ___. (متعب)
questions.explanation_ar: بعد الجري ساعة بحس بالتعب: tired. الكلمة العربية (متعب) معناها tired.
questions.explanation_en: After running for an hour I feel tired: tired. The Arabic word (متعب) means tired.

questions.prompt: When the lesson is long and not fun, I feel ___. (أشعر بالملل)
questions.explanation_ar: الدرس الطويل والممل بيحسسني بالملل: bored. الكلمة العربية معناها bored.
questions.explanation_en: A long, boring lesson makes me feel bored: bored. The Arabic word means bored.

questions.prompt: A new student may feel ___ on the first day. (خجول)
questions.explanation_ar: الطالب الجديد في أول يوم ممكن يبقى خجول: shy. الكلمة العربية (خجول) معناها shy.
questions.explanation_en: A new student on the first day may be shy: shy. The Arabic word (خجول) means shy.

questions.prompt: Yesterday he ___ to the zoo.
questions.explanation_ar: كلمة Yesterday بتدل على الماضي، وماضي go هو went. go للحاضر وgoes للمفرد الغايب.
questions.explanation_en: The word Yesterday shows the past, and the past of go is went. go is for the present and goes is for the third person singular.

questions.prompt: They ___ a lion at the zoo.
questions.explanation_ar: الجملة ماضية، وماضي see هو saw. see للمضارع وseen مش بنستخدمها لوحدها.
questions.explanation_en: The sentence is in the past, and the past of see is saw. see is for the present, and seen is not used alone.

questions.prompt: "خائف" in English: ___.
questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (خائف) معناها scared. happy سعيد وshy خجول.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (خائف) means scared. happy is سعيد and shy is خجول.

questions.prompt: "متحمس" in English: ___.
questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (متحمس) معناها excited. tired متعب وbored زهقان.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (متحمس) means excited. tired is متعب and bored is زهقان.

questions.prompt: She ___ happy because it was her birthday.
questions.explanation_ar: She مفرد وفي الماضي، فنقول was. were للجمع وis للحاضر.
questions.explanation_en: She is singular and in the past, so we say was. were is for plurals and is is for the present.

questions.prompt: They ___ tired after the trip.
questions.explanation_ar: They جمع وفي الماضي (after the trip)، فنقول were. was للمفرد.
questions.explanation_en: They is plural and in the past (after the trip), so we say were. was is for the singular.

questions.prompt: The baby cried because he was ___.
questions.explanation_ar: الطفل بيعيط لما يبقى حزين: sad. happy وexcited مش بيعيّطوا الطفل.
questions.explanation_en: The child cries when he is sad: sad. happy and excited do not make the child cry.

questions.prompt: I ___ my old friend at the park yesterday.
questions.explanation_ar: كلمة yesterday بتدل على الماضي، وماضي see هو saw. see وseeing مش مناسبين.
questions.explanation_en: The word yesterday shows the past, and the past of see is saw. see and seeing do not fit.

questions.prompt: "غاضب" in English: ___.

questions.prompt: We ___ a story about a brave boy.
questions.explanation_ar: ماضي read بيتكتب read لكن بيتنطق ريد (red). readed غلط، لأن الفعل ده مش بياخد ed.
questions.explanation_en: The past of read is written read but pronounced "red". readed is wrong, because this verb does not take ed.

questions.prompt: The mouse was ___ of the cat.
questions.explanation_ar: الفار كان خايف من القطة: scared. happy وexcited مش بيتناسبوا مع القطة.
questions.explanation_en: The mouse was afraid of the cat: scared. happy and excited do not fit with the cat.

questions.prompt: I feel ___ when I help my mom.
questions.explanation_ar: لما أساعد أمي بحس بالسعادة: happy. angry وscared مش مناسبين.
questions.explanation_en: When I help my mom I feel happy: happy. angry and scared do not fit.

questions.prompt: Lina got a new bike. She is ___. (سعيدة)

questions.explanation_en: Laila got a new bike, so she is happy: happy. The Arabic word (سعيدة) is the clue.

questions.prompt: He lost his ball. He is ___. (حزين)

questions.explanation_en: He lost his ball, so he is sad: sad. The Arabic word (حزين) means sad.

questions.prompt: The room is dark. The girl is ___. (خائفة)

questions.prompt: Omar went to the ___.
questions.passage: Omar went to the beach with his family on Friday. He was very excited. He swam in the sea and played with the sand. He made a big sand house with his little brother. At the end of the day he was tired but happy. It was a great day.
questions.explanation_ar: القطعة بتقول: Omar went to the beach. يعني راح البحر (الشاطئ): beach.
questions.explanation_en: The passage says: Omar went to the beach. So he went to the sea (the beach): beach.

questions.passage: Omar went to the beach with his family on Friday. He was very excited. He swam in the sea and played with the sand. He made a big sand house with his little brother. At the end of the day he was tired but happy. It was a great day.
questions.explanation_ar: القطعة بتقول: He was very excited. يعني في الأول كان متحمس: excited.

questions.prompt: he went to the zoo

questions.explanation_en: The correct sentence: He went to the zoo. We start with a capital letter (He) and end with a full stop (.) because it is a regular sentence.

questions.explanation_en: The correct sentence: Were you happy? We start with a capital letter (Were) and end with a question mark (?) because it is a question.

questions.prompt: (walked, played, happy)

questions.explanation_en: The words: walked, played and happy. We use the past in sentences: We walked to school yesterday. happy comes after is or was. We start with a capital letter and end with a full stop. The answer is a model answer and it is checked by reviewing the sentence.
